jobs.title: Unarmed Healthcare Security Officer: Patient Safety & Service
jobs.description:
Baptist Health System Hospital in San Antonio, TX is seeking a dedicated Security Officer 1 (Unarmed) to maintain a safe environment for patients, staff and visitors. You will monitor facilities, respond to incidents, control access and assist with crowd management, traffic and parking as needed.

We value customer service, situational awareness and reliability. This role may qualify for a sign-on bonus and offers opportunities for professional growth within the Baptist Health System.

jobs.title: Hospital Protective Services Shift Lead
jobs.description:
University Health is seeking a capable Police Supervisor for its Protective Services department. The role leads shift operations and enforces general and criminal regulations to safeguard patients, visitors, staff, physicians and property.

Applicants should have 3+ years as a police officer, with hospital security experience preferred; Texas Peace Officer license and TCOLE certification are required, with higher certifications valued.

jobs.title: Healthcare Security Officer (Unarmed) – Great Benefits
jobs.description:

The role offers opportunities to work with advanced technology and contribute to a healthcare community focused on health and safety.
